title: KNOW THE HORN
scriptLine: Short is a second. Long is four to six.

hero.prompt: A chrome marine horn mounted on the bow of a white boat, calm blue lake and desert mountains behind.

meaning.label: WHAT IT MEANS
meaning.text: Boats talk with a horn. The whole language is five lines.

items.label: One short: I'll keep you on my left
Two short: I'll keep you on my right
One long: I'm leaving the dock

cta: Get on the list. Link in bio.
